raids.abdendriel.warwolf.msg_1: Viele aggressive Bestien streifen südlich von Ab'Dendriel umher! Aufpassen!
raids.abdendriel.wasp_bear.msg_1: Waldtiere breiten sich in der Nähe von Ab'Dendriel aus!
raids.ankrahmun.bone_beast.msg_1: In den Ankrahmun Dipthrah-Gräbern rasseln Knochenbestien.
raids.ankrahmun.bone_beast.msg_2: Knochenbestien streifen in den Ankrahmun Dipthrah-Gräbern umher.
raids.ankrahmun.cobra.msg_1: In den Ankrahmun Dipthrah-Gräbern brutzelt etwas.
raids.ankrahmun.cobra.msg_2: Noch knisternder wird es in den Ankrahmun Dipthrah-Gräbern.
raids.ankrahmun.gargoyle.msg_1: In den Ankrahmun Rahemos-Gräbern bewegt sich etwas Steiniges.
raids.ankrahmun.nomad.msg_1: Nomad Späher wurden in der Nähe der Tore von Ankrahmun gesichtet.
raids.ankrahmun.nomad.msg_2:
The desert nomads are launching a full scale attack on Ankrahmun.
		Some might even have slipped through the defences!
raids.ankrahmun.scarab.msg_1: Unusual frequent scarab sightings at the gates of Ankrahmun
raids.ankrahmun.scarab.msg_2: Ancient scarabs are leading an attack on Ankrahmun.
raids.ankrahmun.terramite.msg_1: Something is moving under the surface in the sand north of Ankrahmun!
raids.carlin.orc.msg_1: Some Orcs are assembling in the woods between Carlin and Northport.
raids.carlin.orc.msg_2: Orcs attacking Carlin from the north-east!
raids.carlin.yeti.msg_1: Something is moving to the icy grounds of Folda.
raids.carlin.yeti.msg_2: Many Yetis are emerging from the icy mountains of Folda.
raids.carlin.yeti.msg_3: Numerous Yetis are dominating Folda, beware!
raids.chayenne.chayenne.msg_1: An immense force is approaching Draconia.
raids.chayenne.chayenne.msg_2: Get prepare mortals, the visit of Chayenne is near.
raids.chayenne.chayenne.msg_3: Chayenne has returned to his citadel once more. Be careful there.
raids.darashia.arachir_the_ancient_one.m: Beware of Arachir the Ancient One!
raids.darashia.lions.msg_1: There are more lions than usual west of Darashia.
raids.darashia.lions.msg_2: Even more lions west of Darashia!
raids.darashia.lions.msg_3: Zomba, the king of lions is roaming the Darashia desert!
raids.darashia.minotaurs.msg_1: Minotaurs are preparing an attack in the Darashia Minotaur pyramid!
raids.darashia.minotaurs.msg_2: Minotaurs are attacking Darashia from the north!
raids.darashia.minotaurs.msg_3: Minotaurs are advancing to Darashia grom the north!
raids.darashia.pirates.msg_1: Pillage and plunder! Pirates have been sighted north of Darashia!.
raids.darashia.priestesses.msg_1: The priestesses in Drefia are preparing a black celebration.
raids.darashia.undead_darashia.msg_1: Sightings of undead, west of Darashia! Imminent invasion is suspected!
raids.edron.feroxa.msg_1: An ancient evil is awakening in the grimvale mines.
raids.edron.feroxa.msg_2:
Werewolfs entities are entering the
	mortal realm in the grimvale mines.
raids.edron.feroxa.msg_3: The Feroxa master has revealed itself in the mines of grimvale.
raids.edron.goblins.msg_1: Goblins are converging west of Edron.
raids.edron.orc.msg_1:
Deep under Edron, the Orc population seems to grow rapidly.
		Be careful and take a rope with you!
raids.edron.orshabaal.msg_1: Orshabaal's minions are working on his return to the World. LEAVE Edron at once, mortals.
raids.edron.orshabaal.msg_2: Orshabaal is about to make his way into the mortal realm. Run for your lives!
raids.edron.orshabaal.msg_3: Orshabaal has been summoned from hell to plague the lands of mortals once again.
raids.edron.warlock.msg_1: Some monks have gathered at a stone circle west of Edron. They seem to be up to something.
raids.edron.warlock.msg_2: More monks have gathered at a stone circle west of Edron. Something terrible is going to happen!
raids.edron.warlock.msg_3: Run! Warlocks east of Edron! There seems to be a very unholy gathering!
raids.farmine.beetles.msg_1: Lancer beetles troop up in Farmine. Beware!
raids.farmine.beetles.msg_2: A pack of lancer beetles heads towards the coast!
raids.farmine.draptor.msg_1: The dragons of the Dragonblaze Mountains have  descended to Zao to protect the lizardkin!
raids.farmine.gnarlhounds.msg_1: There seems to be a big gnarlhoud gang in Zao Steppe.
raids.farmine.gnarlhounds.msg_2: The gnarlhounds seem to multiply by the minute.
raids.farmine.gnarlhounds.msg_3: The gnarlhounds roam free in the Zao Steppe. Watch out!
raids.farmine.zulazza_the_corruptor.msg_: A massive orc force is gathering at the gates of Zzaion.
Orc reinforcements have arrived at the gates of Zzaion! The gates are under heavy attack!.
More orc reinforcements have arrived at the gates of Zzaion! The gates are under heavy attack!.
The gates to Zzaion have been breached! Orcs are invading the city!.
More orcs have arrived in Zzaion! The city is under attack! Strong lizard leaders have come to defend the city.
raids.kazordoon.goblins.msg_1: Goblins are preparing to attack Kazordoon from Femor Hills!
raids.kazordoon.goblins.msg_3: Danger! Now the goblin leaders attack Kazordoon from Femor Hills!
raids.liberty_bay.ferumbras.msg_1: The seals on Ferumbras old cidatel are glowing. Prepare for HIS return mortals.
raids.liberty_bay.ferumbras.msg_2: Ferumbras return is at hand. The Edron Academy calls for Heroes to fight that evil.
raids.liberty_bay.ferumbras.msg_3: Ferumbras has returned to his citadel once more. Stop him before its too late.
raids.liberty_bay.morgaroth.msg_1: The ancient volcano on Goroma slowly becomes active once again.
raids.liberty_bay.morgaroth.msg_2: There is an evil presence at the volcano of Goroma.
raids.liberty_bay.morgaroth.msg_3: Evil Cultists have called an ancient evil into the volcano on Goroma. Beware of its power mortals.
raids.liberty_bay.quaras.msg_1: Something is moving in the depths of the sea around Liberty Bay
raids.liberty_bay.quaras.msg_2: Numerous Quara fins have been sighted in the seas around Liberty Bay.
raids.liberty_bay.quaras.msg_3: Quara emerged from the sea to attack Liberty Bay.
raids.liberty_bay.tigers.msg_1: Majestic creatures with stripes roam the small desert at Meriana.
raids.liberty_bay.tortoises.msg_1: Slowly but steady, the population of tortoises grows on liberty island.
raids.port_hope.kongras.msg_1: Lizards Sentinels seem to attack Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.kongras.msg_2: Lizards are advancing to Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.lizards.msg_1: Lizards Sentinels seem to attack Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.lizards.msg_2: Lizards are advancing to Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.serpent_spawn.msg_1: Something bad is happening deep, deep down under Banuta.
raids.port_hope.serpent_spawn.msg_2: Something is sizzling deep under many sheets of soil in Banuta.
raids.port_hope.serpent_spawn.msg_3: Hordes of slippery spawns slither in Deeper Banuta!
raids.port_hope.terrorbirds.msg_1: Terrorbirds have been sighted in Trapwood south-east of Port Hope!
raids.rookgaard.rottie2.msg_1: Something is moving in the northern grounds of the Rookgaard.
raids.roshamuul.gaz_haragoth.msg_1: Something out of the ordinary, it's better we hide now!
raids.roshamuul.gaz_haragoth.msg_2: His strength is unlimited, the demons kneeling before him .!
raids.roshamuul.gaz_haragoth.msg_3: The dreaded Gaz'Haragoth is invading the land from prison.
raids.roshamuul.omrafir.msg_1: Omrafir is about to make his way into the roshamuul prison. Run for your lives!
raids.svargrond.barba_bittermor.msg_1: Barbarians are gathering at Bittermor. They seem to be up to something.
raids.svargrond.barba_bittermor.msg_2: The barbarian pack is roaming around in Bittermor.
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_1: Scouts report a barbarian army gathering near Svargrond.
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_2: Some invaders might try to access Svargrond via the ice to the south west.
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_4: The barbarians attacks on Svargrond are becoming more and more fierce!
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_5: The barbarians are preparing for a final assault on Svargrond. Hide or fight!
raids.svargrond.barbarian.msg_1: Scouts report a barbarian army gathering near Svargrond
raids.svargrond.barbarian.msg_2: Some invaders might try to access Svargrond via the ice to the North.
raids.svargrond.ghazbaran.msg_1: An ancient evil is awakening in the mines beneath Hrodmir.
raids.svargrond.ghazbaran.msg_2: Demonic entities are entering the mortal realm in the Hrodmir mines.
raids.svargrond.ghazbaran.msg_3: The demonic master has revealed itself in the mines of Hrodmir.
raids.svargrond.ice_golems.msg_1: There is a sudden rise in ice golem population in Formogar mines.
raids.thais.cyclops.msg_1: Let da mashing begin! Cyclops riot east of Thais.
raids.thais.orcs.msg_1: Orc activity near Thais reported! Beware!
raids.venore.elves.msg_1: Elf Scouts have been sighted near Venore!
raids.venore.feverish_citizen.msg_1: Feverish Citizens are invading the streets of Venore!
raids.venore.hunter.msg_1: Hunters on the hunt north of the Green Claw Swamp.
raids.venore.the_old_widow.msg_1: The mating season of the giant spiders is at hand. Leave the plains of havoc as fast as you can.
raids.venore.the_old_widow.msg_2: Giant spiders have gathered on the plains of havoc for their mating season. Beware!
raids.venore.undead.msg_1: The dead of the plains of havoc are becoming restless!
raids.venore.undead.msg_2: A veritable army of undead is amassing in the plains of havoc, beware!
raids.venore.undead.msg_3: The dreaded banshee lead their undead minions to claim the plains of havoc!
